figure_candidates.label: Figure 1
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 1. The deprotonation-reprotonation process in STPSs.
a) Previous work on general bases/acids for deprotonation/reprotona-
tion, such as G182/G182-water in selina-4(15),7(11)-diene synthase
(SdS),[8] the D444/D444-Y520 dyad in 5-epi-aristolochene synthase
(TEAS),[9] and PPi/PPi-water in aristolochene synthase.[9] b) Our work
evaluated the molecular basis for the regioselective reprotonation of
intermediate germacrene A (GA) through the investigation of two
highly paralogous sesquiterpene synthases that catalyze distinct
regioselective C3/C6 reprotonation reactions, namely AhCS and AhIS.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 5
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 5. Functional interconversion between AhCS and AhIS and the causation analysis. a) Alignment of the active sites of AF-AhCS (green) and
AF-AhIS (violet). The five different residues are shown in sticks and highlighted in corresponding colors. b) Gas chromatography-mass
spectrometry (GC-MS) analysis of extracts from biochemical reactions of FPP with AhCS, AhIS, and their variants in vitro; the m/z 204 is the
molecular ion of sesquiterpenes. c) A flow chart summarizing the activities of AhCS, AhIS, and their key variants that guide the distinct
regioselective reprotonation of GA to different skeletons 1 and 2. d) The conserved triad in AhIS: the effector (V419), the linker (S418), and the
diphosphate sensor (R459). The main-chain carbonyl oxygen of V419 is pointed towards the active site and it may act as the proton donor in AhIS.
e)(i) The AF-AhCS-GA complex after 20 ns of molecular dynamics simulation (MD). Y538 is close to D542 (4.3 Å) and the C2–C3 double bond
(3.1 Å, 3.1 Å). (ii) The proton donor in AhCS. The Y538 is hypothesized to accept a proton from D542 and donates it to C3 of the GA. f)(i) The AF-
AhIS-GA complex after 20 ns of MD. The carbonyl oxygen of V419 is close to the C6–C7 double bond (3.1 Å, 3.7 Å). (ii) The proton donor in AhIS.
The protonated carbonyl oxygen of V419 is hypothesized to transfer a proton to C6 of the GA through a supposed water.
